definitions.explanation: Indicates many different kinds or types of something. Emphasizes variety and diversity.

examples.japanese: {様々|さまざま}な{意見|いけん}がありました。
この{店|みせ}には{様々|さまざま}な{商品|しょうひん}があります。

notes:
{様々|さまざま} is a na-adjective meaning various or diverse.

FORMS:
- Noun modifier: {様々|さまざま}な + noun
- Predicate: noun + は{様々|さまざま}だ

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {様々|さまざま}な{種類|しゅるい} (various kinds)
- {様々|さまざま}な{理由|りゆう} (various reasons)
- {様々|さまざま}な{問題|もんだい} (various problems)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いろいろ: various (casual, more common in speech)
- {様々|さまざま}: various (slightly more formal)
- {多様|たよう}: diverse (formal, emphasizes diversity)
